steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __rhf.session.readBust('darwin'); __rhf.session.readBust('curie'); __rhf.session.readBust('tharp'); g.screens.close(); __rhf.session.save(); const sci=g.state.science; return 'read '+Object.keys(g.state.busts).join(',')+'; science busts10 '+(!!sci.busts10)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const n=Object.keys(g.state.busts).length; g.screens.open('journal',{tab:'people'}); const tab=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')].map(b=>b.textContent).find(t=>t.startsWith('Scientists')); return 'after reload: '+n+' plaques read ('+Object.keys(g.state.busts).join(',')+'); tab label: '+tab})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close(); for(const id of ['galileo','kepler','newton','leavitt','hubble','lovelace','angstrom']) __rhf.session.readBust(id); g.screens.close(); return 'read '+Object.keys(g.state.busts).length+'; busts10 done: '+(!!g.state.science.busts10)+'; money '+g.state.money})()
